properties.state: {"description":"Take a directory of written specifications and produce one coherent design from the whole corpus, keeping each claim's provenance Fragment pointing back at its source document. Extends single-document extraction, which already works, with the two things a corpus needs and a file does not: a folder driver, and identity resolution ACROSS documents so the same thing named in many specs converges on one node. The primitive for that convergence already exists — every node type declares its own resolution strategy and threshold in the schema — so this is wiring an existing mechanism at batch scale rather than inventing one. Bound by dec:ask-not-repair: suspected duplicates are asked, never silently merged, which at corpus scale means the asking must be batched or the feature is unusable. PLANNED — BL-97.","is_entry_point":false,"is_exit_point":false,"name":"Ingest a folder of specifications as one design","provenance":"authored","status":"verified","tier":"operational"}
